items.titleZh: F1拟推进V8引擎回归 厂商将支持新规
items.summaryZh: F1计划在周一就V8引擎回归迈出关键一步，各制造商准备支持新动力单元规则。消息称当前各家厂商对转向更便宜、更简单、更受车迷欢迎的规则存在广泛共识，倾向采用2.1升V8引擎。

items.originalTitle: F1 poised to take crucial step towards V8 engines' return
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 is set to take a major step forward on Monday toward the return of V8 engines, with manufacturers poised to back new power unit regulations. Sources suggest broad agreement among current carmakers on the shift toward cheaper, less complex and more fan-appealing engines, with a 2.1-litre V8 the idea set to be backed.
detailZh: F1转向V8引擎的计划将于周一迈出重要一步，各制造商准备支持新规则。
在国际汽联、车队和车手进行了数月讨论、就F1下一套规则方向收集反馈之后，一份关于新动力单元的正式提案将在管理机构与制造商的会议上讨论。
消息人士表示，F1当前各家汽车制造商对规则转向存在广泛共识，这些规则旨在确保未来引擎更便宜、更简单，并对车迷更具吸引力。
尽管规则的许多细节仍需微调，但总体而言，看起来将获得支持的想法是采用2.1升V8引擎。
这种配置将有助于最大限度地减少额外支出，因为它避免了需要所有全新的内燃机设计，这些设计可以通过在现有的1.6升V6发动机上增加两个气缸来创建。
V8发动机将配备一个更小的涡轮增压器，降低增压压力，以及一个比当前350千瓦更小的电动元件。
在这方面正在讨论的提议是使用200千瓦的电动机，但其中只有100千瓦始终可用。额外的100千瓦将用于超车或一键加速系统。
然而，并非所有提交给车队的提议都得到了支持，据了解，对于由外部供应商创建标准基线动力单元、然后允许制造商自行修改的想法存在阻力。
一位围场消息人士指出，制造商能否继续致力于F1的关键在于动力单元是否仍是性能差异化的因素。
虽然整体规则概念看起来将向前推进，但需要做出的重大决定是它何时进入F1。
现行规则计划执行到2030年底，这意味着V8引擎将在2031年引入。
然而，国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆急于不等待那么久，并希望批准V8规则变更在2030年就发生。
本·苏拉耶姆上个月表示，他希望新规则能将引擎成本削减至目前水平的一半左右。
本·苏拉耶姆表示：“已经有很多文件发给车队领队和动力单元制造商，车手们也就此接受了咨询。”
“当你把它做得更简单时，就能把价格降到一半。然后如果研发成本减半，凭借这种简化，生产时间也可以更短。”
转向更简单的动力单元之际，也在推动大幅降低赛车重量——国际汽联的目标是让赛车比现在轻80公斤。
正如国际汽联单座赛车总监尼古拉斯·通巴西斯最近所说：“当我们列出购物清单并把所有项目加起来时，我们可以轻松降到700公斤以下。
“现在我们意识到，在讨论问题时，某些领域会有一些反弹。我们将不得不做出一些妥协。
“人们会担心某些成本，但总体而言，我们的目标是低于700公斤，我认为这将是让赛车更令人兴奋的重要一步。”
虽然继续使用涡轮增压意味着下一代V8发动机不会提供过去时代那种尖啸声浪，但涡轮增压的存在将避免可能需要重新引入加油环节。
Tombazis补充道：“总的来说，我们并不热衷于引入加油环节，而且我们也知道各车队对此并不热衷，”他说。
“这会增加一层复杂性和风险，但同样重要的是，它会让赛前的进站窗口变得明确得多。因此，这意味着根据你是否丢失了位置来调整策略的灵活性会大大降低。”
detailEn: Formula 1's plans to move to V8 engines is set for a major step forward on Monday, with manufacturers poised to back new regulations.

Following months of discussions between the FIA, teams and drivers to gather feedback on a direction for F1's next rules set, a formal proposal for the new power units is to be discussed at a gathering of the governing body and manufacturers.

Sources have suggested that there is broad agreement among F1's current carmakers over the shift of rules, which are aimed at ensuring future engines are cheaper, less complex and more appealing to fans.
Although many details of the regulations will still need finetuning, in broad terms the idea that looks set to be backed is for a 2.1-litre V8 engine.

This configuration will help minimise extra expenditure because it avoids the need for all new internal combustion engine designs, as they can be created by adding two cylinders on to the current 1.6-litre V6s.
The V8 will be accompanied by a smaller turbo with reduced boost pressure, as well as a smaller electrical element compared to the current 350kW.

The proposal being discussed on this front is for a 200kW electric motor, but with only 100kW of that available at all times. The extra 100kW would be used for either an overtake or push-to-pass system.

Not all the proposals put in front of teams have been supported though, with it understood there is resistance to one idea for a standard baseline power unit being created by an external supplier, which manufacturers would then be allowed to modify themselves.
One paddock source suggested that critical for manufacturers to continue to commit to F1 is that the power unit remains a performance differentiator.
While the overall rules concept looks like it will move forward, the big decision that needs to be made is when it will arrive in F1.
The current regulations are planned to run through to the end of 2030, meaning the V8s would then come in for 2031.
However, FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem is eager to not wait that long and is hoping to sign off for the V8 rule shift to happen in 2030 itself.
Speaking last month, Ben Sulayem said he hoped that the new rules would cut engine costs to around half of their current level.
"There have been a lot of papers with the team principals and power unit manufacturers, plus the drivers have been consulted about it," said Ben Sulayem.
"When you make it simpler, you can make it half of the price. Then if the R&D goes down by half, with the simplicity the production time can be shorter."
The move to simpler power units will also come amid a push to reduce car weight dramatically – with the FIA targeting cars that are 80kg lighter than now.
As the FIA's single seater director Nikolas Tombazis said recently: "When we do the shopping list and add everything up, we can get quite comfortably below 700kg.
"Now we are conscious that when we discuss things, there will be some kickback in some areas. We'll have to compromise a bit.
"There will be concerns about certain costs, but overall our target is to be below 700kg, and I think it will be a significant step to make the cars more exciting."
While the continued use of a turbo means the next V8s won't offer the screaming sound of previous eras, the turbo's presence will avoid the need for a potential return of refuelling.
Tombazis added: "Generally [we are] not keen to go to refuelling and we also know the teams are not keen to go to refuelling," he said.

"It adds a level of complexity and risk, but also importantly, it makes the pitstop windows far more defined before the race. So it means that there's much less flexibility to adapt to your strategy depending on whether you've lost positions or not."

items.originalTitle: Christian Horner admits Red Bull prospects were thrown in against Max Verstappen too soon
detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳承认红牛车队在对抗马克斯·维斯塔潘时过早地投入了年轻车手
前红牛车队经理克里斯蒂安·霍纳表示，车队在2019年的"残酷"晋升体系下，让皮埃尔·加斯利在心理上崩溃了
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的比赛分析
红牛车队的第二个席位长期以来一直被视为一级方程式中最具压力的环境之一。当米尔顿凯恩斯的运营频繁地更换被高度评价的年轻车手，试图为马克斯·维斯塔潘找到合适的搭档时，前车队经理克里斯蒂安·霍纳现在公开质疑这种无情的车手培养体系的逻辑。
在《高性能播客》中，霍纳回顾了他管理车队的日子，并承认他经常不同意将车手迅速投入到与一代天才对抗的深水区。
“有些车手来得太早了，我并不完全同意他们进入红牛车队的速度，但红牛青训车队中有他们的决心，”霍纳透露。
霍纳将皮埃尔·加斯利、亚历克斯·阿隆和利亚姆·劳森列为过早晋升到高级别座位的潜在例子。
这种发展失败的例子之一是皮埃尔·加斯利在2019年与高级车队短暂的任职。在仅仅在姐妹车队托罗罗索（现更名为小红牛）度过一个完整赛季后，加斯利难以适应高度敏感的红牛底盘和维斯塔潘原始速度带来的巨大压力。
Horner回忆起球队观看法国车手信心崩溃的准确时刻。在那年的奥地利大奖赛和匈牙利大奖赛中，维斯塔潘的速度如此之快，以至于他在赛道上连续两次将加斯利甩在身后。
“你可以明显地看到他们感受到了那种压力，无论是皮埃尔，我记得他在奥地利和匈牙利大奖赛中连续两场比赛被超越，他在那些比赛中已经崩溃了，”Horner表示。
匈牙利大奖赛之后，红牛队突然将加斯利降级回小红牛队，直到赛季结束，并用阿隆索取代了他。
尽管Horner指出红牛体系通常通过允许车手返回青训车队而不是完全解雇他们来提供“降落伞”，但他并没有回避批评环境的残酷现实。
“一方面，红牛所做的是非常慷慨的，但就其执行方式而言，你曾是当月的宠儿，直到你不再是，”霍纳总结道。
detailEn: Christian Horner admits Red Bull prospects were thrown in against Max Verstappen too soon
Former Red Bull boss Christian Horner says the team's "brutal" promotion system mentally broke Pierre Gasly in 2019
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

The second seat at Red Bull Racing has long been viewed as one of the most high-pressure environments in Formula 1. While the Milton Keynes operation frequently cycled through highly rated prospects trying to find a match for Max Verstappen, former team principal Christian Horner is now openly questioning the logic of that ruthless driver pipeline.

Speaking on the High Performance podcast, Horner reflected on his tenure managing the team and admitted that he frequently disagreed with how quickly drivers were thrown into the deep end against a generational talent.

"Some of these drivers were arriving too soon, and I didn't completely agree with the speed at which they were arriving into Red Bull Racing, but there was a determination to have them from the Red Bull Junior pool," Horner revealed.
Horner named Pierre Gasly, Alex Albon, and Liam Lawson as prime examples of prospects who were rushed into the senior seat before they were properly prepared.

One example of this developmental failure was Pierre Gasly's short-lived stint with the senior team in 2019. Promoted after just one full season at sister outfit Toro Rosso (now Racing Bulls), Gasly struggled to adapt to the highly sensitive Red Bull chassis and the immense pressure of Verstappen's raw pace.

Horner recalled the exact moment the team watched the French driver's confidence collapse. During both the Austrian and Hungarian Grand Prix that year, Verstappen's pace was so blisteringly fast that he lapped Gasly on track.

"You could visibly see that they were feeling that pressure, whether it was Pierre, I remember [him] getting lapped in Austria and at the Hungarian Grand Prix two races in a row, and he was broken in those races," Horner stated.
Immediately following the Hungarian Grand Prix, Red Bull abruptly demoted Gasly back to Toro Rosso for the remainder of the season, replacing him with Albon.

While Horner noted that the Red Bull system usually provided a "parachute" by allowing drivers to return to the junior team rather than firing them completely, he did not shy away from criticising the harsh reality of the environment.
"It was, on the one hand, hugely generous what Red Bull were doing, but it was quite brutal in terms of its execution that you were the flavour of the month until you weren't," Horner concluded.
keyPointsZh: 霍纳公开质疑车手培养逻辑
keyPointsEn: Horner openly questions the logic of the ruthless driver pipeline

items.originalTitle: Topps reveals Gem Mint 10 Lando Norris card with Coca-Cola suit patch
items.summaryEn: Topps has revealed one of its rarest Lando Norris cards: a signed 2024 Dynasty Formula 1 card featuring two pieces of race suit, one of them cut from the Coca-Cola logo on the sleeve of his McLaren race suit.
detailZh: Topps展示评级为Gem Mint 10的兰多·诺里斯可口可乐战袍补丁卡
这张2024 Dynasty签名卡在诺里斯签名下方嵌有两块比赛服布料
致迈凯伦车迷。来自沃金的木瓜色新闻，包括车手、赛车、车队策略以及每个比赛周末的最新动态。
Topps公布了一张极为稀有的兰多·诺里斯卡片：一张2024 Dynasty系列F1签名卡，嵌有两块比赛服布料，其中一块取自其迈凯伦赛车服袖口上的可口可乐标志。
Topps Racing 账号周五在 Instagram 上发布了一段这张卡片的短视频，配文是“这张兰多·诺里斯补丁签名卡简直疯了！”
这张卡片来自 Single Driver Dual Relic Autograph 系列。诺里斯的签名下方有两个红色布料窗口。左边那块布料上能看到白色可口可乐手写体标志的一部分。
它已由美国公司 PSA 完成评级，并被封存在塑料评级盒中，获得了该公司的最高等级 Gem Mint 10。
车迷们立刻发现了这个标志。“他们从哪儿弄到他的赛车服的？”帖子下一位评论者问道。“天哪，这太酷了，”另一个人评论道，还有人补充说：“哈哈哈可口可乐想回西班牙看看因为可口可乐瓶子引发的混乱。可口可乐，来当 LN4 Fusion 的赞助商吧！”
在新建的马德里赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛之后，诺里斯在冷却室里的一幕让他迅速走红。当时似乎有人要求诺里斯放下他正在喝的可口可乐，但他拒绝了。“我刚跑完一场比赛，所以我有权喝我想喝的东西。非常感谢，”诺里斯当时说道。
这一幕在网上引发了轩然大波，因为可口可乐的竞争对手百事公司是F1的官方合作伙伴。
在得克萨斯州奥斯汀接受媒体采访时，诺里斯被进一步追问此事。“没有，之后没人再跟我说过什么。我觉得比赛结束后我们应该被允许喝任何我们想喝的东西，尤其是当你在车里待了两个小时的时候。
“这已经是一些最炎热的比赛了，赛车也很难驾驶，所以我觉得我应该被允许喝我想喝的东西。”
他补充道：“从车队角度来说，车队可能比我受到更多责备。因此我们用来装饮料的杯架很小，所以没有品牌标识，但我可以喝任何我能喝的东西。只是他们存在品牌方面的问题。”
“但这不是我需要考虑、或者应该考虑的事情，所以这肯定是一些已经在其他人之间解决掉的事情。我想事情就是这样。只是电视和品牌之类的事情，但我可以喝任何我喜欢的东西。”
Dynasty 是 Topps 生产的最昂贵的 F1 产品。每盒装有一张封装卡，总是带有纪念物的签名卡，且每张都编号为 10 张或更少。当 2024 版于 2025 年 2 月发售时，一盒售价 1,099.99 美元。
这张诺里斯卡片的基础版本限量 10 张，上面还有更稀有的红色、黑色和金色版本。
detailEn: Topps reveals Gem Mint 10 Lando Norris card with Coca-Cola suit patch
The signed 2024 Dynasty card features two race suit relics beneath Norris’s autograph
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

Topps has shared one of its rarest Lando Norris cards: a signed 2024 Dynasty Formula 1 card with two pieces of race suit, one of them cut from the Coca-Cola logo on the sleeve of his McLaren race suit.
The Topps Racing account posted a short video of the card on Instagram on Friday, with the caption "This Lando Norris patch auto goes CRAZY!"
The card comes from the Single Driver Dual Relic Autograph set. Two windows of red fabric sit below Norris's signature. The left-hand piece shows part of the white Coca-Cola script.
It has been graded by the American company PSA, which sealed it in a plastic case with its highest grade, Gem Mint 10.

Fans spotted the logo straight away. "Where did they get his race suit?" asked one of the commenters under the post. "Omg this is so dope," someone else commented, while another added: "Hahaha Coca-Cola wants to come back to Spain and see the chaos that erupted over the Coca-Cola bottle. Coca-Cola, become a sponsor of LN4 Fusion!"

Norris went viral after the Spanish Grand Prix at the new Madring Circuit during a moment in the cooldown room. Norris was seemingly asked to put down the Coca-Cola he was drinking, but he refused. “I just did a race, so I’m allowed to drink what I would like. Thank you so much,” Norris said at the time.
The moment caused chaos online as PepsiCo, a rival of Coca-Cola, is an official partner of F1.

Norris was pressed further on the situation while speaking to the media in Austin, Texas. “No, no one’s ever said anything to me since. I feel like we should be allowed to drink whatever we want after a race, especially when you’re in it for two hours.
"It’s been some of the hottest races, cars are also difficult to drive, so I feel like I should be allowed to drink what I want.”

He added: “From a team, the team might have been told off more than I was. And therefore we have little holders to put our drinks in, so it’s unbranded, but I’m allowed to drink whatever I can. It’s just the branding issues that they have.

"But this is not something I need to be thinking of, or I should be thinking of, so it’s some stuff I’m sure that was cleared up between other people. That’s simply all it was I think. It’s just TV and branding and all of those things, but I can drink whatever I like.”

Dynasty is the most expensive F1 product Topps makes. Each box holds a single encased card, always an autograph with a relic, and every one is numbered to 10 copies or fewer. When the 2024 edition went on sale in February 2025, a box cost $1,099.99.
The base version of this Norris card is limited to 10 copies, with rarer red, black and gold versions on top.

2026年一级方程式冠军基米·安东内利已将红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘选为最有可能阻碍他2027年卫冕的车手
在系列赛中仅第二个赛季，梅赛德斯车手在墨西哥大奖赛上成为了F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军，当时年仅20岁68天，也是自1953年阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来首位赢得冠军的意大利人。
但在周四在圣马力诺举行的新闻发布会上，安东内利明确表示，他预计下个赛季的竞争将更加激烈，并指出了四次冠军得主是他的主要对手。
“如果我要选择一个车手，我会说马克斯——他可能是造成最多问题的那个人，”安东内利用意大利语说。
维斯塔潘以两分的差距错过了2025年的冠军，落后于麦克拉伦的兰多·诺里斯。他赢得了过去五场大奖赛中的三场，以279分排在车手积分榜第二位，落后安东内利111分。
安东内利承认，梅赛德斯在开赛六场大奖赛全部获胜的领先优势已经不复存在。
“去赛道赢得比赛，以证明我们仍然是最好的，这一点非常重要。红牛、麦克拉伦和法拉利已经缩小了差距，我们不再像赛季初期那样统治。我们之间的性能差距更小了，而且从赛道到赛道，力量平衡也可能发生变化，”他说。
“很难说我们能否在预算帽和风洞使用时间限制下重复这样的表现，因为我们已经获胜，这些限制对我们来说现在更低了。”
安东内利欢迎更加激烈的竞争前景。
“当然。赛季的结束已经可以让我们对下一年有所了解。在每个大奖赛上与那些级别的车手竞争对我来说将是一个巨大的挑战，”他说。
这位20岁的年轻人也坚持认为，他的冠军头衔并没有减弱他的渴望。
“尽管赢得了比赛，但我可能比之前更渴望。胜利是一种美好的感觉，也是可以发生在你身上的最好的事情之一。你想要一次次地重温那个时刻，”安东内利说。 “对我来说，这些最后的比赛已经是为2027年的准备，所以目标是好好结束这一年，也许能赢得几场比赛，并尝试在下一年重复它。这只是开始。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli names biggest threat to 2027 title defence as he warns Mercedes advantage may fade
The 20-year-old says this season's closing races will help prepare for his 2027 defence
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
2026 Formula 1 champion Kimi Antonelli has chosen Red Bull's Max Verstappen as the driver most likely to stand in the way of his title defence in 2027.

In only his second season in the series, the Mercedes driver became F1's youngest world champion at the Mexican Grand Prix, at the age of 20 years and 68 days, and the first Italian to win the title since Alberto Ascari in 1953.
But speaking at a press conference in San Marino on Thursday, Antonelli made it clear that he expects a much tougher fight next season, and named the four-time champion as his main rival.
"If I had to choose one driver, I'd say Max - he's the one who might cause the most problems," Antonelli said, speaking in Italian.

Verstappen missed out on the 2025 title by just two points to McLaren's Lando Norris. He has won three of the last five grands prix and sits second in the drivers' standings on 279 points, 111 behind Antonelli.
Antonelli admitted that Mercedes' advantage from the opening races, when it won the first six grands prix, has gone.

"It's very important to go to the track and win to show that we're still the best. Red Bull, McLaren and Ferrari have got a lot closer and we're not as dominant as we were at the start of the season. The performance between us is closer, and from track to track the balance of power can change," he said.
"It's difficult to say whether we'll be able to repeat it with the budget cap and the limits on wind tunnel hours, which are lower for us now that we've won."
Antonelli welcomed the prospect of a closer battle.

"Definitely. The end of the season can already give us an idea of what next year could be like. It would be a great challenge for me to have to fight drivers of that calibre at every grand prix," he said.
The 20-year-old also insisted his title had done nothing to dull his appetite.

"Despite the win, I'm maybe even hungrier than before. Winning is a beautiful feeling and one of the best things that can happen to you. You want to relive the moment more and more," Antonelli said. "These last races are already preparation for 2027 for me, so the goal is to finish the year well, maybe with a few wins, and try to repeat it next year. It's only the beginning."

七届F1冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿批评前车手对系列赛中年轻明星的"说坏话"，并表示他一直决心不成为"那种车手"。
这位英国人在Interlagos被问及基米·安东内利的冠军成功是否让他对自己的职业生涯有所反思。在汉密尔顿决定在2025年转会法拉利后，梅赛德斯车队签下了安东内利。在仅仅第二个赛季，这位意大利车手成为了F1最年轻的世界冠军。
"看到新的人出现，年轻的驾驶员，我感到非常自豪。我看到很多这些前F1驾驶员，年长的F1驾驶员，赛车驾驶员总是对年轻人说些负面的话，"汉密尔顿说。
他补充说，尽管这些驾驶员自己也经历过类似的事情，但他们却表现出"没有同情心"，并说："我总是想确保我不会成为那种驾驶员。"
这位41岁的法拉利车手，在圣保罗完成了他的第400场大奖赛发车，表示他对整个车队的年轻驾驶员印象深刻。
“他们每周都带着所有的压力出现。当然，作为赛车手，我们非常幸运，但到达这里并保持冷静，不断失败并重新站起来，这是一项巨大的挑战，”他说。
“这是赛车运动的顶峰。这是做得好的最困难平台。犯错误太容易了，”他说，并补充说他尊重他们每个人的“站起来，继续前进”的方式。
安东内利是本赛季几位给人留下深刻印象的年轻车手之一。在赢得九场大奖赛并夺得冠军的过程中，他获得了16个领奖台，而红牛车队的伊萨克·哈德贾，22岁，在他的第二个赛季中获得了三个领奖台。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton criticises ex-F1 drivers for "talking smack" about young stars
The Ferrari driver said he was proud of the young talent emerging across Formula 1
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Seven-time Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton has criticised former drivers for "talking smack" about the young stars of the series, saying he has always been determined not to become "that type of driver".

The Briton was asked at Interlagos whether Kimi Antonelli's title success had made him reflect on his own career. Mercedes signed Antonelli after Hamilton decided to move to Ferrari in 2025. In only his second season, the Italian driver became F1's youngest world champion.

"I'm just really proud to see new people coming through, young drivers. I see a lot of these ex-Formula 1 drivers, older Formula 1 drivers, racing drivers just talking smack about young people all the time," Hamilton said.
He added that even though those drivers had been through something similar themselves, they showed "no empathy", and said: "I always wanted to make sure that I would not be that type of driver."
The Ferrari driver, who is 41 and made his 400th grand prix start in Sao Paulo, said he was impressed by young drivers right through the field.

"They're all showing up every single week with all the pressures that they have. Of course, we're very privileged as racing drivers, but there are massive challenges to arrive and keep your head up and keep failing and getting back up," he said.

"This is the pinnacle of motorsport. It is the hardest platform to do well in. It's so easy to make mistakes," he said, adding that he respected the way each of them kept "getting up and picking up and just continuing to push".

Antonelli is one of several young drivers to have impressed this season. As well as winning nine grands prix on his way to the title, he has 16 podiums, while Red Bull's Isack Hadjar, 22, has taken three podium finishes in his second season.

detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳解释为什么维斯塔潘的“异常”驾驶风格摧毁他的队友
前红牛车队负责人克里斯蒂安·霍纳解释了马克斯·维斯塔潘的“异常”驾驶风格是如何使得车辆对队友来说难以驾驶的
马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队、克里斯蒂安·霍纳、红牛车队
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说。关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的赛事分析。
过去五年里，围绕小红牛车队的叙述始终是关于一群车手在试图与维斯塔潘并肩作战的过程中挣扎——并且经常失败。
前车队负责人克里斯蒂安·霍纳最近为这一现象提供了一个技术解释。
在天空体育的高性能播客中，霍纳透露，那个臭名昭著的第二辆小红牛车座的"诅咒"实际上源于工程部门试图满足维斯塔潘独特的物理输入。
霍纳在回顾领导车队的时间时解释说："维斯塔潘对想要的东西要求极高，他拥有非同寻常的技能。"
在一级方程式赛车中，车辆的设置通常是转向不足和转向过度之间的折衷。大多数车手更喜欢相对可预测的平衡，这样他们可以在弯道中建立信心，并在出弯时应用油门而不需要不断进行突然的修正。
然而，维斯塔潘却在设置谱系的极端端运行。他拥有非凡的能力，可以人为地平衡一个松散的、滑动的后端，这使得他可以要求超灵敏的转向，在进入弯道时使车辆激进地旋转。
维斯塔潘，红牛车队，与Christian Horner，红牛车队车队负责人
"他不断要求车辆提供更多的前轮抓地力，而他可以应对后轮为了追求这个目标而做的一切," Horner指出。
因为维斯塔潘在获得这种极端设置时，他的性能上限非常高，整个红牛的技术开发路径自然地跟随他的反馈，从底盘中提取最大圈速。
霍纳承认，不可避免的是，你的工程部门、你的工具、你的开发重点都会走向创造那种特性，而其他人发现很难驾驭。
尽管维斯塔潘利用这种超灵敏的前端获得了多个世界冠军，但他的队友们，他们依赖于更传统、可预测的车辆平衡，通常发现自己在与一台他们无法信任的机器搏斗。
正如霍纳解释的那样，进入第二辆红牛的驾驶员不仅要与维斯塔潘竞争；他们还要与一台针对他们自然驾驶偏好而设计的车辆竞争。
detailEn: Christian Horner explains why Max Verstappen’s “abnormal” driving style destroys his team-mates
Former Red Bull boss Christian Horner explains how Max Verstappen's "abnormal" driving style makes the car undrivable for team-mates
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Christian Horner, Red Bull Racing
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
The narrative surrounding Red Bull Racing over the last half-decade has consistently featured a rotating cast of drivers struggling - and often failing - to survive alongside Max Verstappen.
Former team principal Christian Horner recently provided a technical explanation for the phenomenon.

Speaking on the High Performance podcast, Horner revealed that the infamous "curse" of the second Red Bull seat is actually rooted in the engineering department's attempt to satisfy Verstappen's unique physical inputs.
"Max is tremendously demanding for what he wants, and he has a skill that is abnormal," Horner explained when reflecting on his time leading the squad.

In Formula 1, a car set-up is typically a compromise between understeer and oversteer. Most drivers prefer a relatively predictable balance, allowing them to build confidence through the corners and apply the throttle on exit without making constant, sudden corrections.

Verstappen, however, operates on the extreme end of the set-up spectrum. He possesses an exceptional ability to artificially balance a loose, sliding rear end, allowing him to demand hyper-responsive steering that rotates the car aggressively upon entry.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, with Christian Horner, Team Principal, Red Bull Racing
"He demands more and more front end from the car, and he can just cope with whatever the rear does in pursuit of that goal," Horner noted.

Because Verstappen's ceiling of performance is so incredibly high when he is given this extreme set-up, the entire Red Bull technical development path naturally follows his feedback to extract maximum lap time from the chassis.
"Inevitably, your engineering department, your tools, your development focus goes down the route of creating that characteristic in a car, which others found difficult to handle," Horner admitted.

While Verstappen has used this hyper-responsive front end to secure multiple world championships, his team-mates, who rely on a more traditional, predictable car balance, have routinely found themselves wrestling a machine they cannot trust.
As Horner explained, drivers stepping into the second Red Bull is not just fighting Verstappen; they are fighting a car engineered against their natural driving preferences.

items.summaryEn: Red Bull has retained Liam Lawson for another year after his impressive 2026 season, but keeping him is only the first step if the team wants to avoid repeating past mistakes.
detailZh: 留住利亚姆·劳森还不够——红牛必须停止把他当作失败者
红牛用又一年F1合同奖励了利亚姆·劳森令人印象深刻的2026赛季，但如果想避免重蹈覆辙，留住他只是第一步
利亚姆·劳森2025年在红牛车队从未失败。是红牛辜负了利亚姆·劳森。
再留他一年不仅是合乎逻辑的决定，或许也是这支组织正在改变赫尔穆特·马尔科时期所形成习惯的首个迹象。然而，为避免再次辜负劳森，它可能还需再迈出一步。
它不能再把年轻车手——包括劳森——当作有保质期的商品来对待。
几乎没有人会不同意，这位新西兰人不仅凭借今年的表现配得上留在F1，而且在长期对未来毫无明确答案的压力下赢得了这个权利。许多人可能早就崩溃或变得沮丧，但红牛很好地训练了他如何屏蔽这种压力，不让它影响自己的表现。
他今年最强的一段时期，恰好与围场里越来越多人提出同一个问题、而且声音越来越大的时期重合：这家伙还得做什么才能确保自己的未来？
最终的确认来自连续五场比赛拿分，其中四场以第七名完赛，让他在中游集团中独树一帜。这段期间还包括一些惊艳的排位赛表现和赛道上的大胆超车。他在积分榜上排名第九，积分是排在身后一位的皮埃尔·加斯利的兩倍多。而小红牛如今看来将锁定队史最佳成绩，很大程度上要归功于劳森的贡献。
劳森在2026赛季无疑是他迄今为止最强的赛季，至少在一级方程式（F1）中是这样。但这也是他第一次真正能够证明自己能力的机会，而不像2025年初那样被临时征召或仓促推入不可能完成的任务中。
劳森在红牛车队那几场比赛的糟糕表现，其实并没有让任何人感到意外——似乎只有车队自己例外。然而，在他晋升的处境下——仅仅参加了11场F1比赛后就被安排与马克斯·维斯塔潘同处一个车库——还期望他能交出明显更好的成绩，这就像期望一个刚毕业的医学生在入职第二天就进行开胸心脏手术。或者像一个消防员在第一次出警时就被派进燃烧的摩天大楼，甚至还没从树上救过一只猫。
然而那两场比赛至今仍在某种程度上决定了人们对劳森的看法——或许这也是为什么确认他的未来花了这么长时间的原因之一。认为他是一个曾经得到机会却失败了的车手的想法，似乎仍然主导着一些人对劳森的评价，无论是在红牛内部还是外部。
但如果你干脆忘掉那几个月——这位新西兰人本人似乎也暗示他已经这样做了，无论是有意为之还是作为一种自我保护——画面就完全不同了。他在2023年代替丹尼尔·里卡多出战时表现出色，然后在一年后最终取代这位澳大利亚人时，又以强劲的表现结束了赛季。
但劳森迄今为止的F1生涯，尽管从未更换过雇主，却一直极其碎片化。先是与法恩扎车队的两段短暂效力，随后是匆忙被提拔进红牛，接着又遭降级。有趣的是，即便在今年——他即将首次以季前测试时相同的车队完成赛季——他仍被征召参加了三场比赛，顶替伊萨克·哈贾尔。
不过，关于劳森2026赛季有一件重要的事需要记住。这不仅仅是他最好的一年。这或许正是他最好的一年，因为他终于能够展示出，当自己不被当作填补突然空缺座舱的应急方案时，他究竟能做到什么。今年的VCARB 03是他在F1中第一辆真正可以称之为自己的赛车，他去年参与了它的研发，并在赛季开始前对其进行了充分的测试。
是的，劳森也更有经验了。但他仍然只有24岁，考虑到他在F1已经经历的一切，这多少有些难以理解。而且，如果不是2025年3月的失败，他现在会被视为在敲红牛的大门，而不是为留在小红牛的权利而战。
随后决定拒绝尼古拉·措洛夫、以留住劳森，这不仅表明红牛对这位新西兰人本赛季表现的高度评价。这或许也是一个明确的信号，表明该组织正开始远离马尔科那种毫不妥协的方式，以及他倾向于做出突然、戏剧性决定的作风。
不可否认，这位奥地利人通过他的青训计划打造了极其成功的体系，其成果比任何批评都更有说服力。即便在当前的发车格上，也有许多前红牛青训车手是由马尔科带入F1的。但同样真实的是，有些车手在那个体系下从未达到自己的全部潜力。
最顶尖的那些人，包括马尔科的方法培养出的两位四届世界冠军，都是他判断力的终极证明。然而也有像让-埃里克·维尔涅、塞巴斯蒂安·布埃米，甚至丹尼尔·科维亚特这样的车手，如果他们没有被忽视、被扫地出门或过早提拔，或许本可以贡献更多。
还有更多名字可以列举——而且，毕竟他们中的大多数人也把自己的职业生涯以及在其它锦标赛或车队取得的成功归功于红牛和马尔科本人。但有一种不可否认的感觉：其中一些人本可以为那个在他们年轻时选中他们的组织带来更多。
劳森的F1生涯现在可能就像维尔涅在2014年底那样结束了——当时这位法国人在红牛二队效力三个赛季后未获留用，而在塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔决定转投法拉利时，他也没有得到晋升红牛的机会。
让-埃里克·维尔涅在红牛二队时与丹尼尔·里卡多不相上下，但他们的F1生涯却走上了截然不同的道路。
马尔科反而将科维亚特匆忙提拔进大车队，尽管在他们共处的唯一一个赛季里，维尔涅的积分轻松超过了这位俄罗斯人。JEV此后再也没能在F1找到另一个席位，尽管他此前几乎与丹尼尔·里卡多不相上下。科维亚特当时的处境，与十年后缺乏经验的“救火队员”劳森所面临的如出一辙——而在被提拔仅仅一年多之后，他就失去了红牛的车手席位。
但如果红牛真的在改变做法，它也需要停止把劳森当作失败者。因为一年半前失败的不是他，而是一个用同一把尺子衡量所有人的体系：如果你和维斯塔潘一样出色，你就能生存下来。但并非人人如此——不仅是在绝对天赋方面，也在于他们的成长方式。毕竟，一代一遇的天才之所以是一代一遇的天才，恰恰是因为他们很稀有。
现在有一些关于劳森具备世界冠军潜力的说法——这很F1。当某人令人印象深刻时，总会有这样的议论。对于一个有天赋的车手来说，这是个好听的标签，但它的意义，和仅仅两场比赛后就彻底否定一个人差不多。
劳森在2027年的赛季很可能将在一种猜测的背景下开始，即这可能是他在F1的最后一年。因为多年来在马尔科的管理下，红牛已经让我们习惯于相信，其年轻车手都有一个到期日，如果他们在那个日期到来之前没有设法进入高级车队，就必须为下一代让路。
但这真的是正确的做法吗？
这可能是红牛需要自己回答的问题。而如果留住劳森确实标志着一种改变，也许该组织应该更清楚地表明，从现在起情况将有所不同——一位表现出色的车手不应该仅仅因为变得太有经验就害怕被扫地出门。
无论是否具备世界冠军潜力，劳森已经证明他足够优秀，能够在F1中比赛——并且为他所效力的车队做出出色的工作。
而且继续把他当作失败者对待，也无助于那支车队让他发挥出最佳水平。
detailEn: Retaining Liam Lawson isn't enough – Red Bull must stop treating him like a failure
Red Bull has rewarded Liam Lawson's impressive 2026 season with another year in F1, but retaining him is only the first step if it wants to avoid repeating its past mistakes
Liam Lawson never failed at Red Bull Racing in 2025. It was Red Bull that failed Liam Lawson.

Retaining his services for another year isn't just a logical decision, but perhaps the first sign that the organisation is changing the habits it developed under Helmut Marko. Yet there may be one more step it needs to take to avoid failing Lawson again.
It needs to stop treating its young drivers – Lawson included – like goods with an expiry date.

There's hardly anyone who would disagree that the New Zealander not only deserved to stay in F1 after his performances this year, but also earned that right under the pressure of having no clarity over his future for so long. Many would probably have cracked or become frustrated, but Red Bull trained him well in how to shield himself from that pressure and not let it affect his performance.

His strongest spell of the year coincided with a period when the paddock was increasingly asking the same question, and doing so more and more loudly: what else does this guy have to do to secure his future?

The final confirmation came after a run of five races in the points, four of which he finished seventh, putting him in a class of his own in the midfield. That run also included some stunning qualifying performances and bold moves on track. He's ninth in the standings, with more than double the points of Pierre Gasly, who occupies the next position in the championship table. And it's largely thanks to Lawson's contribution that Racing Bulls now looks set to secure its best result in the team's history.

Lawson's 2026 is surely his strongest season to date, at least in F1. But it's also the first in which he's actually been able to prove what he's capable of without being called up as a stand-in or rushed into an impossible task, as happened in early 2025.

Lawson's dreadful couple of races for Red Bull didn't really come as a surprise to anyone – apart, seemingly, from the organisation itself. Yet expecting him to deliver something substantially better in the circumstances of his promotion – being placed in the same garage as Max Verstappen after just 11 F1 starts – was like expecting a newly graduated medical student to perform open-heart surgery on his second day in the job. Or a firefighter being sent into a burning skyscraper on his first call, without even having rescued a cat from a tree.

Yet those two races remain a somewhat defining part of how Lawson is perceived today – and perhaps one of the reasons why it took so long to confirm his future. The idea that he's someone who had his chance and failed still seems to dominate some people's assessment of Lawson, both outside and within Red Bull.

But if you simply forget those couple of months – which the New Zealander himself seemed to suggest he had done, whether consciously or as a form of self-protection – the picture looks completely different. He did well when standing in for Daniel Ricciardo in 2023, and then had a strong end to the season when he finally replaced the Australian a year later.

But Lawson's F1 career to date, despite him never changing employers, has been incredibly fragmented. There were those two short spells with the Faenza team, then the mad rush into Red Bull, followed by his demotion. Funnily enough, even this year – the first in which he's about to finish the season with the same team he started pre-season testing with – he was still called up for three races to stand in for Isack Hadjar.

Still, there's one important thing to remember about Lawson's 2026. It's not just his best year. It may be his best precisely because he's finally been able to show what he's capable of when he's not being used as an emergency solution to fill a suddenly vacant cockpit. This year's VCARB 03 is the first car he can truly call his own in Formula 1, having worked on its development last year and tested it properly ahead of the championship.

Lawson's also more experienced, yes. But he's still just 24, which is somewhat difficult to comprehend given how much he's already been through in F1. And if it weren't for the failure of March 2025, he'd now be seen as banging on Red Bull's door rather than fighting for the right to stay with Racing Bulls.

The subsequent decision to deny Nikola Tsolov a place in order to retain Lawson isn't just an indication of how highly Red Bull rates the New Zealander's season. It's also perhaps a clear sign that the organisation is beginning to move away from Marko's uncompromising approach and his tendency towards sudden, dramatic decisions.

There's no denying that the Austrian built something incredibly successful with his junior programme, and the results of his work speak louder than any criticism. Even on the current grid, there are plenty of former Red Bull juniors who were brought into F1 by Marko. But it's also true that some drivers never reached their full potential under that system.

The best of the best, including the two four-time world champions produced by Marko's approach, are the ultimate proof of his judgement. Yet there are also drivers like Jean-Eric Vergne, Sebastien Buemi and even Daniil Kvyat, who potentially had more to offer had they not been overlooked, shown the door or promoted too early.

There are more names to go through – and, after all, most of them also owe their careers and their successes in other championships or teams to Red Bull and Marko himself. But there's an undeniable feeling that some of them could have delivered more for the organisation that picked them up at a young age.

Lawson's F1 career could now have ended just as Vergne's did at the end of 2014, when the Frenchman wasn't retained by Toro Rosso after three seasons but didn't get his promotion to Red Bull when Sebastian Vettel decided to leave for Ferrari.
Jean-Eric Vergne was a match for Daniel Ricciardo at Toro Rosso, but their F1 careers took very different paths

Marko rushed Kvyat into the senior team instead, despite Vergne comfortably outscoring the Russian in their single season together. JEV never found another seat in F1, despite having previously been almost a match for Daniel Ricciardo. Kvyat was in the same position as the inexperienced firefighter Lawson would find himself in a decade later – and lost his Red Bull drive just over a year after being promoted.

But if Red Bull really is changing its approach, it also needs to stop treating Lawson as a failure. Because it wasn't him who failed a year and a half ago, but a system in which everyone was judged by the same yardstick: if you're as good as Verstappen, you'll survive. But not everyone is – not only in terms of absolute talent, but also in the way they develop. After all, generational talents are generational talents precisely because they're rare.

There's some talk now about Lawson having world championship potential – which is typical F1. When someone impresses, there's always going to be talk about it. It's a nice phrase to attach to a talented driver, but it's about as meaningful as writing someone off completely after two races.

Lawson's 2027 will probably begin against a backdrop of speculation that it could be his final year in F1. Because over the years under Marko, Red Bull has conditioned us to believe that its young drivers have an expiry date, and that if they haven't somehow made it into the senior team before that date arrives, they must make way for the next generation.
But is that really the right approach?

That may be a question Red Bull needs to answer for itself. And if retaining Lawson really does signal a change, maybe the organisation should make it clearer that things will be different from now on – that a driver who is performing shouldn't have to fear being shown the door simply because he's become too experienced.
World championship potential or not, Lawson has proved he's good enough to race in F1 – and to do a great job for the team he's racing for.
And continuing to treat him like a failure isn't going to help that team get the best out of him, either.

detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳将红牛领导结构归咎于错失F1的未来之星
克里斯蒂安·霍纳将他的权限不足和红牛的领导层归咎于错失三名F1明星
对于红牛的粉丝来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的比赛分析。
多年来，红牛车队在车队经理克里斯蒂安·霍纳和赛车运动顾问赫尔穆特·马克奥之间的双重领导结构被赞扬为一种无情的但非常有效的系统。但现在，霍纳将这种管理风格指向正是米尔顿凯恩斯车队错失兰多·诺里斯、乔治·拉塞尔和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的主要原因。
在《高性能播客》中，霍纳将自己与组织的一次侦察失误区分开来。而不是简单地承认车队没有达到目标，霍纳强调他对红牛青训车队缺乏管辖权，认为公司动态意味着他对自己的未来车手阵容没有发言权。
霍纳明确表示：“我从未负责年轻车手项目。”
霍纳透露，诺里斯、拉塞尔和皮亚斯特里的父亲实际上是在付钱给红牛使用工厂的专业模拟器。
霍纳解释说：“乔治·拉塞尔在付钱让我们使用我们的模拟器，兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里也是如此。他们的父亲在给他们开支票，让他们在我们的驾驶员模拟器上驾驶。”
这些独立客户很快证明，他们比红牛车队重金培养的青训车队要优秀得多。霍纳回忆起他的模拟器工程师对他说，'克里斯蒂安，这些孩子比我们目前拥有的青训车手要强。'
克里斯蒂安·霍纳，红牛车队，赫尔穆特·马克，红牛车队
尽管霍纳是赢得锦标赛的运营公司的首席执行官和车队负责人，但他没有公司权力向这些青少年提供合同。他被迫在自己的工厂里充当中间人，将数据带给拥有绝对否决权的马克。
'我记得把他们带到赫尔穆特面前，说，'看，我真的认为你应该看看这些人...'，霍纳表示。
因为马克奥领导着红牛青训车队，他能够拒绝车队主管的建议，使得三名车手最终都能与竞争对手车队签约。
detailEn: Christian Horner blames Red Bull leadership structure for missing F1’s future stars
Christian Horner blames his lack of jurisdiction and Red Bull's leadership for missing out on three F1 stars
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

For years, Red Bull Racing's dual-leadership structure between team principal Christian Horner and motorsport advisor Dr. Helmut Marko was praised as a ruthless but highly effective system. But Horner is now pointing to that exact management style as the primary reason the Milton Keynes squad lost out on Lando Norris, George Russell, and Oscar Piastri.

Speaking on the High Performance podcast, Horner distanced himself from one of the organisation's scouting blunders. Rather than simply admitting the team missed the mark, Horner highlighted his lack of jurisdiction over the Red Bull Junior Team, arguing the corporate dynamic meant he had no say in his own future driver line-up.
"I never had responsibility for the young driver programme," Horner explicitly stated.
Horner revealed that the fathers of Norris, Russell, and Piastri were literally paying Red Bull to use the factory's professional simulator.
"George Russell was paying us to go on our simulator, as were Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri," Horner explained. "Their dads were writing cheques for them to run on the driver simulator that we had."

The telemetry quickly proved that these independent customers were vastly superior to Red Bull's heavily funded junior roster. Horner recalled his simulator engineers telling him, "'Christian, these kids are better than the juniors we've got at the moment.'"
Christian Horner, Red Bull Racing, Helmut Marko, Red Bull Racing

Yet, despite being the CEO and team principal of the championship-winning operation, Horner had no corporate authority to offer the teenagers a contract. He was forced to act as a middleman in his own factory, taking the data to Marko, who held absolute veto power over the driver pipeline.
"I remember taking them to Helmut and going, 'Look, I really think you should look at these guys...'" Horner stated.
Because Marko headed the Red Bull Junior Team decisions, he was able to reject the team principal's advice, allowing all three drivers to eventually sign with rival constructors.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯维修区承认：法拉利的糟糕表现缓解了圣保罗站的冠军压力
梅赛德斯领导层承认，法拉利在巴西的糟糕表现缓解了确保车队冠军的所有压力
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和从布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
当在英特拉戈斯下雨时，通常会有混乱。对于梅赛德斯来说，2026年圣保罗大奖赛是一场混乱的比赛。这个位于布拉克利的车队来到巴西，需要执行一场干净的赛事来正式结束车队冠军争夺，但很快发现自己在一个难以预测的湿滑赛道上作斗争。
乔治·拉塞尔和刚刚获得车手冠军的基米·安东内利在比赛中都遭遇了打滑，这导致驾驶舱内环境变得紧张。但梅赛德斯维修区墙上，对冠军头衔的推测却出奇地清晰。
在NU银箭广播秀播客节目中，梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·阿利森和副车队总监布拉德利·洛德透露，车队从未感到有压力要保守地关注积分。原因很简单：他们最接近的对手法拉利在车队排名下游的表现灾难性。
当被问及维修区是否曾不得不将注意力严格转向锦标赛数学时，阿利森打断了对马拉内洛车队速度的直率评价。
“此外，法拉利这场比赛表现糟糕；即使我们面前的戏剧性场面也没有在任何阶段让红色赛车看起来会给我们带来麻烦，”阿利森表示。
虽然刘易斯·汉密尔顿在他的法拉利车上从第20位发车，实现了精彩的起步，但车队在复杂条件下速度很快下降。来自马拉内洛的持续威胁不足让梅赛德斯车队可以完全专注于自己的恢复赛程。
洛德立即支持了阿利森的评估，指出梅赛德斯策略师从未真正担心失去对制造商冠军的控制。
“是的，刘易斯有那个惊人的起步……[但是]他们似乎在进步然后又退步，你看到他们超车然后又被超车，”洛德解释说。“所以我认为在整个比赛中，我们实际上在任何时候都不会失去冠军，因为我们始终在赛道上领先法拉利。”
最终的排名完全证实了维修区轻松的态度。虽然兰多·诺里斯为麦克拉伦赢得了胜利，但梅赛德斯车队成功确保了2026年的制造商冠军，罗素以第四名结束比赛，安东内利恢复到第五名。
与此同时，法拉利只收获了微薄的积分。查尔斯·勒克莱尔以第八名的成绩冲过终点线，比第九名的汉密尔顿高一位。斯库德里亚未能充分利用梅赛德斯混乱的赛事，最终让托托·沃尔夫的队伍在剩余三轮比赛中锁定了冠军。
detailEn: Mercedes pitwall admits floundering Ferraris relieved title pressure in São Paulo
Mercedes leadership admits Ferrari's "rubbish race" in Brazil relieved all the pressure of securing the Constructors' title
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

When the rain falls at Interlagos, chaos usually follows. For Mercedes, the 2026 São Paulo Grand Prix was a turbulent affair. The Brackley-based squad arrived in Brazil needing to execute a clean race to officially wrap up the constructors' championship, but quickly found themselves battling a highly unpredictable wet-dry track.

Both George Russell and newly crowned drivers' champion Kimi Antonelli suffered spins during the race, leading to a stressful environment inside the cockpits. But on the Mercedes pitwall, the focus remained surprisingly clear of title permutations.

Speaking on the NU Silver Arrows Radio Show podcast, Mercedes technical director James Allison and deputy team principal Bradley Lord revealed that the team never felt pressured to conservatively points-watch. The reason was simple: their closest rival, Ferrari, was putting in a disastrous performance further down the order.
When asked if the pitwall ever had to shift its focus strictly to the championship maths, Allison interjected with a blunt assessment of the Maranello outfit's pace.
"Also, Ferrari were having such a rubbish race; even our dramas in front of them were not really making it look like, at any stage, the red cars were going to trouble us," Allison stated.

While Lewis Hamilton managed a brilliant initial launch from 20th on the grid in his Ferrari, the team's pace quickly evaporated in the tricky conditions. The lack of a sustained threat from Maranello allowed Mercedes to focus entirely on its own recovery drives.
Lord immediately backed up Allison's assessment, noting that the Mercedes strategists were never genuinely concerned about losing their grip on the constructors' crown.

"Yeah, Lewis had that amazing start... [but] they were sort of making progress and then falling back, and you saw them overtaking and then being passed again," Lord explained. "So I don't think there was any point in the race where we actually wouldn't have taken the championship regardless, because we were always ahead of the Ferraris on the road."

The final classification completely validated the pitwall's relaxed stance. While Lando Norris took the victory for McLaren, Mercedes successfully secured the 2026 constructors' championship with Russell finishing fourth and Antonelli recovering to fifth.

Meanwhile, Ferrari walked away with a meagre points haul. Charles Leclerc crossed the line in eighth place, just one position ahead of Hamilton in ninth. The Scuderia's inability to capitalise on Mercedes' scrappy race ultimately allowed Toto Wolff's squad to seal the title with three rounds to spare.

detailZh: 伊斯坦布尔如何改造其F1赛道以锁定长期未来
伊斯坦布尔公园赛道将于明年重返F1赛历。这条赛道深受车手喜爱，布局将保持不变，但在赛事本身方面，组织者希望吸取过去的教训，对其进行大幅改造。
在现代一级方程式中，找到合适的平衡往往是一项挑战。这同样适用于技术规则：一方面要在满足车手和纯粹主义者之间取得平衡，另一方面要呈现F1希望为年轻车迷提供的观赏性，并不断带来超车动作——比如说，面向TikTok一代。
但这种平衡术也适用于赛历和F1造访的举办地。许多近期新增的目的地是位于迈阿密、拉斯维加斯和马德里等迷人地点的临时赛道，但这些未必是让铁杆车迷兴奋的赛道。
然而，明年赛历上将回归一场有潜力将两者优势结合起来的比赛。伊斯坦布尔是一座全球性城市——欧洲与亚洲之间的桥梁——因此正是F1希望纳入赛历的那种目的地。但这条位于博斯普鲁斯海峡亚洲一侧的赛道，也是一条能吸引车手和车迷的赛道，尤其是因为它著名的8号弯。
在土耳其大奖赛回归之前，Motorsport.com 与土耳其汽车运动联合会（TOSFED）主席埃伦·乌奇莱尔托普拉吉进行了交谈。他同样抱有将两方面结合起来的雄心：一场符合现代F1标准的赛事，同时保留一条铁杆车迷喜爱的赛道。
“是的，我也这么认为，”乌奇莱尔托普拉吉说。“从车迷的角度来看，我们总是更渴望观看老派赛道上的比赛，所以F1接受了我们的提议、我们重返赛历是件好事。我们都怀念过去的比赛，但归根结底，从商业角度来说，我们也需要像马德里这样的比赛。两者我们都需要，现代街道赛道，以及像伊斯坦布尔、蒙扎和银石这样的赛道。”
话虽如此，所有永久性赛道都必须做出调整，以符合现代F1在设施和赛事整体呈现方面的标准。伊斯坦布尔的赛道布局将保持不变，但其周边将会有很大变化。
“赛道将进行重大升级，”乌切尔托普拉吉解释道。“我们将把赛道现代化到一级方程式赛车目前达到的水平。我们当然也在基础设施方面开展工作。我们将尝试覆盖大部分看台，并尝试打造车迷区，尽一切必要努力为车迷提供最佳体验。”
最后一点是这些计划的关键支柱。伊斯坦布尔公园赛道过去一直是车手们的最爱，但据乌切尔托普拉吉所说，未来五年——即新合同的期限——最大的挑战是让它同样成为车迷们的最爱；在这方面还有很多工作要做。
“它一直是一条车手赛道，但现在我们正努力让它也成为一条车迷赛道，”他说。“这要从交通管制和人群管理开始。周边道路已经以新的方式建成，因此现在有进入道路和离开道路。交通流将得到改善，让进出赛道的体验更好。”
后者尤为重要，因为此前几届土耳其大奖赛期间的交通相当混乱。这是乌切尔托普拉吉很清楚的一个问题。
“我们知道该做什么。我们已经开始规划基础设施，同时也在扩建围场。容量将翻倍，基础设施将从头建设。除此之外，我们还将改善接待设施，包括利用我们著名的8号弯。”
在这次赛事改革中，有一个方面特别值得注意：与以往几届相比，未来几年的土耳其大奖赛在组织方式上将大不相同。TOSFED不仅是土耳其赛车运动联合会，现在还是推广方——这一次，这应该意味着更直接的沟通渠道，以及更强的能力真正将雄心转化为行动。
“赛道管理权已移交给TOSFED，因此作为推广方，在把事情办成方面形成了一种新的流程。一切都将由我掌控，并在国家的支持下，我们将尽力采取一切必要措施，”乌切尔托普拉吉说道。
“最糟糕的部分是，在我们管理之前，赛道由一家私营公司管理，他们的优先事项不是这项运动，不是车迷，也不是一级方程式。所以不幸的是，我们在车迷体验方面遇到了问题，这就是为什么我们现在优先考虑车迷体验。”
伊斯坦布尔公园赛道计划如何避免进一步的沥青问题
除此之外，乌切尔托普拉吉知道基本要素仍需到位。赛道布局不会改变，沥青需要处于更好的状态。在F1最近几次造访期间，路面被证明存在问题，促使多位车手将其描述为“在冰上驾驶”——尤其是2020年下雨的那个周末，刘易斯·汉密尔顿正是在那里锁定了他的第七个世界冠军。
“是的，当时沥青确实有问题，这一点我完全支持你，”乌切尔托普拉吉承认道。
“我们并不太赞成在距离比赛仅剩很短时间的情况下重新铺设表层。部分问题在于赛道上没有举办过比赛，所以在F1之前没有比赛，这意味着我们遇到了路面问题。”
不出所料，伊斯坦布尔的组织者迫切希望避免在2027年重蹈那些问题的覆辙。
“目前，我们正与国际汽联（FIA）以及赛道专家密切合作，”他继续说道。“当然，我们需要更换路缘石等设施，但赛道布局将保持不变。而且我想这次我们不会更换沥青路面。”
“它将保持不变，目前我们每年至少在伊斯坦布尔公园举办30周的‘体验活动’。在翻新和升级之后，我们将在F1之前重新开始举办国内和国际赛事。”
这应能防止F1车手在抓地力水平方面再次遭遇令人不快的意外。
土耳其大奖赛能否在2031年之后继续留在赛历上？
所有这些最初都是基于五年合同来推进的，但乌切尔托普拉吉希望伊斯坦布尔在初始协议之后仍能留在赛历上，这意味着这些投资着眼于更长期的目标。
“我们正在研究一个更长的期限。这就是为什么我们目前关于赛道的项目将超过五年。我们正在内部以及与州政府讨论如何扩大这个项目，而不会再次离开赛历，”他说。
乌切尔托普拉吉非常清楚实现这一目标需要什么：兑现上述承诺。如果做到这一点，他相信其余的事情会自然随之而来。
“当然，我们的承诺首先是五年，但如果我们能达到一级方程式（Formula 1）所要求的标准，那么对双方都有利。只要我们履行了所做出的承诺，并且未来五年能让车迷满意，那么我认为将伊斯坦布尔留在赛历上对双方都有利，”他总结道。
detailEn: How Istanbul is revamping its F1 circuit to clinch long-term future

Istanbul Park will return to the F1 calendar next year. Beloved by drivers, the layout will remain intact, but when it comes to the event itself, the organisers want to learn from the past and give it a substantial overhaul

Finding the right balance is often a challenge in modern Formula 1. That applies to the technical regulations: striking a balance between satisfying drivers and purists on the one hand, and delivering the spectacle F1 wants to offer younger fans on the other, with a constant stream of overtaking moves for, let’s say, the TikTok generation.

But that balancing act also applies to the calendar and the venues F1 visits. Many of the recently added destinations are temporary circuits in glamorous locations such as Miami, Las Vegas and Madrid, but these are not necessarily the tracks that get diehard fans excited.

Next year, however, a race will return to the calendar that has the potential to combine the best of both worlds. Istanbul is a global city – the bridge between Europe and Asia – and therefore the kind of destination F1 likes to have on its calendar. But the circuit, located on the Asian side of the Bosphorus, is also one that appeals to drivers and fans, particularly because of its famous Turn 8.

Ahead of the Turkish Grand Prix's return, Motorsport.com sat down with Eren Uclertopragi, president of the Turkish Automobile Federation (TOSFED). He shares the ambition of bringing both aspects together: an event that meets the standards of modern F1, while retaining a circuit that diehard fans enjoy.

“Yes, I think the same,” Uclertopragi said. “From a fans’ perspective, we are always more eager to watch the races in old-school tracks, so it's good that F1 accepted our proposal and that we are back on track. We all miss the old races, but at the end of the day, from the commercial side, we also need the races like Madrid. We need both, the modern street tracks and tracks like Istanbul, Monza and Silverstone.”

That said, all permanent circuits have to adapt to meet the standards of modern F1, both in terms of facilities and the overall presentation of the event. The layout in Istanbul will remain intact, but a great deal will change around it.

“There will be major upgrades to the circuit,” Uclertopragi explained. “We will modernize our circuit to the level F1 reaches right now. We are, of course, working on the infrastructural side. We will try to cover most of the grandstands and we will try to make fan zones to do whatever is necessary to give the best experience to the fans.”

That last point is a crucial pillar of the plans. Istanbul Park has been a drivers’ favourite in the past, but according to Uclertopragi, the biggest challenge for the next five years – the duration of the new contract – is to make it a fan favourite as well; there is a lot of work to be done in that respect.

“It was always a drivers’ circuit, but now we’re trying to make it a fan circuit as well,” he said. “That starts with the traffic control and crowd management. The surrounding roads have already been constructed in a new way, so that there are now incoming roads and outgoing roads. The traffic flow will be improved to make the experience of getting into the circuit and getting out of the circuit better.”
The latter is particularly important, as traffic during previous editions of the Turkish Grand Prix was rather chaotic. It is an issue Uclertopragi is well aware of.

“We know what we have to do. We have started already planning the infrastructure and we are expanding the paddock as well. The capacity will be doubled and the infrastructure will be done from scratch. Apart from that, we will improve our hospitality units, including using our famous Turn 8.”

One aspect is particularly noteworthy in this overhaul of the event: the Turkish GP will be organised very differently in the coming years compared to previous editions. TOSFED is not only the Turkish motorsport federation, but now also the promoter – something that should mean more direct lines of communication and greater ability to actually turn ambitions into actions this time.

“The management of the circuit has been handed out to TOSFED, so that is creating a new flow with regards to getting things done as a promoter. Everything will be in my hands and with the support of the state, so we will try to do whatever is necessary,” Uclertopragi said.

“The worst part is that prior to our management, the circuit was managed by a private company and their prioritization was not the sport, not the fans, not Formula 1. So unfortunately we had problems with the fan experience and that is why we are prioritizing that fan experience right now.”
How Istanbul Park plans to avoid further asphalt issues

Aside from that, Uclertopragi knows that the fundamentals still need to be right. The layout will not change, and the asphalt needs to be in better condition. The surface proved problematic during F1's most recent visits, prompting several drivers to describe it as “driving on ice” – especially when it rained in 2020, the weekend when Lewis Hamilton secured his seventh world championship.
“Yeah, there was a problem with the asphalt back then, I totally support you on that,” Uclertopragi admitted.

“We were not a big fan of resurfacing the top layer with only a short period of time to go before the race. Part of the problem was that there were no races held at the circuit, so there was no race prior to F1 and that meant we had the surface problem.”
Unsurprisingly, the organisers in Istanbul are keen to avoid a repeat of those problems in 2027.

“Currently, we are in close cooperation with the FIA and experts from the circuit,” he continued. “Of course, we will need to change the kerbstones and so on, but the layout will be the same. And I guess we will not be changing the tarmac this time.

“It will remain the same and currently we are hosting ‘experience events’ at Istanbul Park for at least 30 weeks a year. After the renovation and upgrades we will start holding national and international races again, prior to Formula 1.”
This should prevent F1 drivers from once again being confronted with an unpleasant surprise when it comes to grip levels.
Can the Turkish GP stay on the calendar beyond 2031?

All of this is initially being done with the five-year contract in mind, but Uclertopragi wants Istanbul to remain on the calendar beyond the initial deal, meaning the investments are aimed at the longer term.

“We are looking into a longer period. That's why the projects that we are having right now about the circuit will be going beyond five years. We are discussing internally and with the state how we can expand this project without leaving the calendar again,” he said.
Uclertopragi knows all too well what is needed to achieve that: delivering on the aforementioned promises. If that happens, he believes the rest will follow naturally.

“For sure, our commitment is for five years first of all, but if we deliver the standards that Formula 1 is looking for, then it will be beneficial for both parties. As long as we deliver the commitments we had and if we will have happy fans in the next five years, then I think it will be beneficial for both parties to keep Istanbul on the calendar,” he concluded.

梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·阿利森详细描述了车队在F1低谷期间经历的"自我厌恶"和痛苦
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
在F1中，经过公关培训的执行人员通常会把失去赛季描述为"学习机会"，并承诺车队将迅速反弹。但梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·阿利森最近打破了这种光鲜的叙述，揭示了冠军荒的心理现实
在连续八次获得车队冠军的历史性纪录之后，梅赛德斯经历了四个表现不佳的艰难赛季。现在，在梅赛德斯于2026年正式夺回冠军之后，艾里森（Allison）公开谈到了在这段间隔年份里布拉克利工厂内部的氛围。
乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）、梅赛德斯、安德烈亚·基米·安东内利（安东内利）、梅赛德斯
在NU银箭广播节目中，梅赛德斯老板承认，通过锦标赛或粉丝的角度来看待2026年的冠军很困难。相反，他的关注点完全集中在同事们的情感救援上。
“我发现很难从我们现在的混乱中抽身出来，去考虑体育和粉丝，”艾里森承认。“我只是想着我的朋友们和队友们，他们在过去几个赛季中经历了表现不佳，以及随之而来的所有自我怀疑，甚至是极端的自我厌恶。”
从主导到中场的竞争，对负责设计和操作汽车的工作人员的打击很大。阿隆索解释说，修复之前挑战者如W13和W14的空气动力学缺陷，不仅是一个技术挑战，也是工程人员个人的、情感上的战斗。
当被问及他将如何记住2026年的胜利赛季时，阿隆索直接指向了他员工在多年质疑自己能力后的情感救赎。
乔治·拉塞尔、梅赛德斯、安德烈亚·基米·安东内利、梅赛德斯、托托·沃尔夫、梅赛德斯
“现在我们得到了一个赛季的回报，我们说了我们要做什么，我们告诉彼此我们要做什么，我们互相要求的是什么非常艰难，然后我们做到了，”阿隆索表示。“我知道我们集体做到了这一点，我内心深处的满足感……实际上，中间季节的所有相对痛苦都使我们现在感受到的更加真实。”
随着梅赛德斯庆祝其第九个车队 constructors' championship 和车手基米·安东内利的创纪录冠军，艾莉森解释说，工厂的心理恢复是 2026 赛季真正的胜利。
"这就是我将记住这一年直到我太老无法再想其他事情的方式，" 艾莉森总结道。
detailEn: Mercedes technical director details the psychological toll of F1 underperformance
Mercedes technical director James Allison details the "self-loathing" and misery the team endured during its F1 slump
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

In Formula 1, PR-trained executives routinely frame losing seasons as "learning opportunities" and promise that the team will quickly bounce back. But Mercedes technical director James Allison recently stripped away that polished narrative to reveal the psychological reality of a championship drought.

Following a historic run of eight consecutive constructors' championships, Mercedes endured four difficult seasons of underperformance. Now, after Mercedes officially reclaimed the title in 2026, Allison opened up about the internal atmosphere inside the Brackley factory during those intervening years.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

Speaking on the NU Silver Arrows Radio Show, the Merc boss admitted it is hard to view the 2026 title through the lens of the championship or the fans. Instead, his focus remains entirely on the emotional rescue of his colleagues.

"I find it very hard to lift myself out of the melee we're in and to think about the sport and the fans," Allison confessed. "I just think about my friends and team-mates that have lived the last seasons of underperformance and all of the self-doubt and, at the extreme, self-loathing that accompanies that."

The drop from domination to fighting in the midfield took a toll on the workforce responsible for designing and operating the cars. Allison explained that fixing the aerodynamic flaws of previous challengers such as the W13 and W14 was not just a technical challenge, but a personal, emotional battle for the engineering staff.
When asked how he will remember the triumphant 2026 season, Allison pointed directly to the emotional redemption of his staff after years of questioning their own abilities.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes

"To have the payoff now of a season where we said what we were going to do, we told each other what we were going to do, and what we asked of each other was extremely tough, and then we've done it," Allison stated. "The bone-deep feeling of contentment that I have in knowing that collectively that's what we have done together... actually all of the relative misery of the intervening seasons makes more valid what we're feeling now."

As Mercedes celebrates its ninth constructors' championship and driver Kimi Antonelli's historic title, Allison explained that the psychological recovery of the factory is the true triumph of the 2026 campaign.
"That's how I will remember this year until I'm too old to think of anything else," Allison concluded.
